title: Make the native/standard inheritance overlap regression distinguish an unguarded standard spawn
outcome: Make the native/standard inheritance overlap regression distinguish an unguarded standard spawn
acceptance: A controlled unguarded negative witness demonstrably leaks a pipe writer or fails the regression, while the guarded launcher reaches EOF with the unrelated child still alive.
A deterministic observation at the standard spawn-lock boundary holds the native inheritance window open while the standard launch attempts to cross it.
